Package dayplanner

Class Time

java.lang.Object
dayplanner.Time
All Implemented Interfaces:
Comparable<Time>
public class Time extends Object implements Comparable<Time>
Represents a specific instance in time, with minute precision. In all methods of this class, the following representations are used:
  • A year is represented by an integer, i.e. 
    1970.
  • A month is represented by an integer, i.e. 
    1 = January.
  • A day is represented by an integer; i.e. 
    1 = 1
    (the first day of the month).
  • An hour is represented by an integer; i.e. 
    23 = 23:xx = 11:xx pm.
  • A minute is represented by an integer; i.e. 
    1 = xx:01.

    • Time

      public Time()
      Instantiates a new Time with no initial fields. Each field defaults to the minimum allowed values.

    • Time

      public Time(int year, int month, int day, int hour, int minute)
      Instantiates a new Time with each required field specified. If any field is not valid, it defaults to its minimum allowed value.
      Parameters:
      year - The new Time's year.
      month - The new Time's month.
      day - The new Time's day.
      hour - The new Time's hour.
      minute - The new Time's minute.

    • Time

      public Time(String formatString)
      Instantiates a new Time based on the given formatString.
      Parameters:
      formatString - Format String of the format YYYY/MM/DD HH:MM. Input is validated against specified minimum and maximum values; if any field is not valid, it defaults to its minimum allowed value. Note: This parameter's required format matches the return format of toString() exactly.

      public static String getValidationError(int year, int month, int day, int hour, int minute)

    • isValidTime

      public static boolean isValidTime(int year, int month, int day, int hour, int minute)
      Validates whether the specified date and time values represent a valid time.
      Parameters:
      year - The year (must be positive, starting from 1).
      month - The month (1-12).
      day - The day (1 to max days in month).
      hour - The hour (0-23).
      minute - The minute (0-59).
      Returns:
      true if all values are valid, false otherwise.

    • setYear

      public void setYear(int year)
      Attempt to set the specified year. Subject to input validation based on the allowed range of years. If the new field is not valid, the operation cancels without affecting the instance. Must be 1 through 9999 inclusive.
      Parameters:
      year - The new year.

    • setMonth

      public void setMonth(int month)
      Attempt to set the specified month. Subject to input validation based on the allowed range of months. If the new field is not valid, the operation cancels without affecting the instance. Must be 1 through 12 inclusive.
      Parameters:
      month - The new month.

    • setDay

      public void setDay(int day)
      Attempt to set the specified day. Subject to input validation based on the allowed range of days. If the new field is not valid, the operation cancels without affecting the instance. Must be 1 through 31 inclusive, depending on the month and leap year rules.
      Parameters:
      day - The new day.

    • setHour

      public void setHour(int hour)
      Attempt to set the specified hour. Subject to input validation based on the allowed range of hours. If the new field is not valid, the operation cancels without affecting the instance. Must be 0 through 23 inclusive.
      Parameters:
      hour - The new hour.

    • setMinute

      public void setMinute(int minute)
      Attempt to set the specified minute. Subject to input validation based on the allowed range of minutes. If the new field is not valid, the operation cancels without affecting the instance. Must be 0 through 59 inclusive.
      Parameters:
      minute - The new minute.
